In ancient Indian society, performing rituals was an essential part of daily life, and those who held authority or ruled were often those who conducted important ceremonies or controlled significant temples. This name would have instilled a sense of pride and reverence for one's spiritual heritage and the importance of upholding rituals in everyday life.
